metas.name: Ali G: Who Iz I?
metas.description: Hip-hop journalist Ali G returns after 20 years to make a documentary with real people. Cameras follow him for over a year as he takes classes, walks the streets, and appears on shows, often with his pregnant girlfriend.

metas.name: The Dog Stars
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a virus wipes out humanity. Survivors face roaming scavengers called Reapers. Protagonist Hig, a pilot, survived the flu but lost his wife.

metas.name: You+Me - Against the World
metas.description: Alma Lancaster, conceals her filmmaking ambitions from her rich family who believe she's in law school. She falls for rebel Vadim Arcadi, while creating a student film. Someone observes, poised to reveal secrets that could destroy...

metas.name: Street Fighter
metas.description: Street Fighters Ryu and Ken reunite when Chun-Li recruits them for the World Warrior Tournament. As they face a hidden conspiracy, they must confront each other and their past-or face destruction.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
metas.description: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

metas.name: Verity
metas.description: Lowen Ashleigh gets hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who's unable to finish after an accident. Lowen uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to...

metas.name: Digger
metas.description: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

metas.name: Ice Cream Man
metas.description: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

metas.name: Masterplan
metas.description: A master thief enlists two strangers for a Louvre heist targeting the Mona Lisa, then reveals they're his children and siblings who must cooperate to pull off history's greatest art theft.

metas.name: The Uprising
metas.description: Based on the true story of the uprising that inspired the legend of Robin Hood, Andrew Garfield stars as the leader of a rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II in a fight for justice.

metas.name: Norm: The Tale of Norm MacDonald
metas.description: Judd Apatow's documentary on Norm Macdonald uses archival footage, photos, and home videos to chronicle the SNL legend's career—from "Weekend Update" anchor to master of absurd, deadpan comedy whose influence endures.

metas.name: By Any Means
metas.description: A notorious mafia hitman and a young Black FBI agent team up to investigate the murders of civil rights leaders in 1966 Mississippi.

metas.name: V/H/S/Mixtape
metas.description: It presents a new anthology in which music and sound become a source of terror.

metas.name: Lo dejamos acá
metas.description: A renowned psychoanalyst, disillusioned with traditional therapy, begins to secretly intervene in his patients' lives, achieving remarkable results - until a creatively blocked writer enters his practice.

metas.name: De Gaulle: Résistance
metas.description: A powerful account of Charles de Gaulle's journey during World War II, from his rise as a military leader to his emergence in French politics between 1940-1945.

metas.name: Tenzing
metas.description: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

metas.name: Runner
metas.description: A former soldier and his unlikely partner become the targets of a ruthless cartel while racing to complete a critical medical delivery and save the life of a little girl.

metas.name: The Odyssey
metas.description: After the Trojan War, Odysseus faces a dangerous voyage back to Ithaca, meeting creatures like the Cyclops Polyphemus, Sirens, and Calypso along the way.

metas.name: Love of Your Life
metas.description: Maya, a smart, wry nurse, is swept up in an immersive love, that sets her life on a trajectory she never would have imagined.

metas.name: Black Box
metas.description: Vero Airlines Flight 298 from New Orleans to Seattle becomes the center of a chilling supernatural mystery.

metas.name: Practical Magic 2
metas.description: A multi generational family of witches, cursed to be loveless for centuries, attempts to break the spell by confronting dark secrets and sacrificing for each other.

metas.name: Animals
metas.description: Desperate to pay their son's ransom, a mayoral candidate and his wife resort to extreme measures, revealing dark secrets they never intended to bring to light.

metas.name: Doing Life
metas.description: A single mother fighting to survive and a reformed ex-con with untapped talent find in each other an unlikely second chance.

metas.name: Schumacher '94: The Birth of a Legend
metas.description: Follows 25-year-old Michael Schumacher's breakthrough 1994 Formula 1 season, featuring his first Grand Prix win in Brazil and the dramatic events of one of F1's most exciting racing seasons, including Ayrton Senna's accident.

metas.name: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
metas.description: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

metas.name: Unabomber
metas.description: A Harvard student becomes the Unabomber after psychological experiments. Years later, an FBI agent's pursuit reveals how his past shaped his deadly campaign that killed 3 and injured 23 from 1978-1995.

metas.name: The Love Hypothesis
metas.description: After an impulsive kiss, two scientists end up in a fake relationship, testing their theories about love and each other.

metas.name: Best of the Best
metas.description: A raucous comedy set in the cut-throat world of collegiate Bollywood dance competitions.

metas.name: Run Hide Fight: Infidels
metas.description: When radical Islamic terrorists hijack a liberal college's pro-Palestine encampment, a ragtag band of red-blooded students, a security guard, and a Delta Force vet must arm up to save their clueless peers.

metas.name: Don't Look Back in Anger
metas.description: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

metas.name: Call My Agent! The Movie
metas.description: Follows a former talent agent turned aspiring director who must reunite with her old team when her lead actor drops out days before filming begins.

metas.name: Drawn Together
metas.description: After her mysterious kidnapping in NYC, Spanish tycoon's daughter Marfil Cortés gets bodyguard Sebastián Moore. Despite clashing personalities, attraction grows as they face escalating threats in Spain, where appearances deceive.

metas.name: Why Did I Get Married Again?
metas.description: Jasmine loves Wesley, and their wedding is near - but her stern father and others disapprove, prompting couples around them to question their own "perfect" marriages.

metas.name: Mayday
metas.description: Lieutenant Troy Brennan's reconnaissance mission over Soviet territory goes awry, forcing him to crash-land and survive in Russian wilderness while evading capture or rescue.

metas.name: Onslaught
metas.description: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

metas.name: The Runner
metas.description: A high-powered attorney must race through London to save her abducted son while following cryptic commands from a mysterious caller.

metas.name: Fall 2: Deadpoint
metas.description: Grieving her sister Shiloh's death, Jax Hunter bonds with Shiloh's bold friend Luce. Together they tackle dangerous Mount Kwan in Thailand. When a rockslide traps them on a narrow plank 4,000 feet up, Jax must face her fears to su...

metas.name: Coyote vs. Acme
metas.description: After enduring years of malfunctioning products, Wile E. Coyote teams up with a local personal injury attorney to take on ACME, the manufacturer of anything and everything used by the Looney Tunes characters.

metas.name: Just Play Dead
metas.description: A criminal plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmaneuver each other in a deadly battle of wits.

metas.name: Buddy
metas.description: A brave girl and her friends must escape a kids television show.

metas.name: The Last Sunrise
metas.description: A young American woman with health challenges finds unexpected romance with a charismatic local during her summer in Majorca, forcing her to weigh her heart's desires against family obligations and her planned return home.

metas.name: Batman: Knightfall - Part 1: Knightfall
metas.description: When the mysterious behemoth known only as Bane frees Batman's entire rogue's gallery from Arkham Asylum, the Caped Crusader is pushed to his mental and physical breaking point.

metas.name: Tony
metas.description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

metas.name: Facing El Chapo
metas.description: Follows two cops who in a routine stop pull over a stolen car only to come face to face with one of the most dangerous criminals in the world.

metas.name: Mutiny
metas.description: After his billionaire industrialist boss is murdered in front of him, Cole Reed is set up to take the fall for the crime -- leaving him on the run as he works to uncover an international conspiracy.

metas.name: Insidious: Out of the Further
metas.description: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

metas.name: The Rivals of Amziah King
metas.description: Amziah King, beekeeper, musician, and anchor of his community, reunites with former foster daughter Kateri after many years apart, and fends off threats to his honey business.

metas.name: The End of Oak Street
metas.description: The Platt family bands together to navigate their new surroundings after a cosmic event transports their suburban neighborhood to someplace unknown.

metas.name: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
metas.description: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

metas.name: The Brink of War
metas.description: President Reagan races to save a nuclear deal with Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev as pressure mounts all around him. Every word spoken could move the world closer to peace - or destruction.

metas.name: Camp Rock 3
metas.description: At Camp Rock, the Connect 3 are looking for a new opening act for their tour. Among campers like Sage, Desi, Rosie, and others, the competition to win the coveted spot sparks rivalries and romances as everyone fights to stand out.

metas.name: One Night Only
metas.description: Two New Yorkers search for love on the one night of the year when pre-marital sex is legal.

metas.name: Super Troopers 3
metas.description: When Farva's over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny's sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny's schemes to break up the relationship, all while trying to bring down a pernicious new drug ring.

metas.name: The Last House
metas.description: A family of four is suddenly sealed inside their house with no way out and must work together to survive against both their dwindling resources and the mysterious, looming threat that is keeping them trapped.

metas.name: Soulm8te
metas.description: A man acquires an Artificially Intelligent android to cope with the loss of his recently deceased wife. In an attempt to create a truly sentient partner, he inadvertently turns a harmless lovebot into a deadly soulmate.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

metas.name: I Want Your Sex
metas.description: Elliot lands a job for Erika Tracy as her sexual muse.

metas.name: The Devil's Mouth
metas.description: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.

metas.name: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
metas.description: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands.

metas.name: The Dink
metas.description: A washed-up tennis pro tries to save a club by reluctantly playing pickleball to earn his father's respect.

metas.name: The Truthers
metas.description: Ruth, a 30-year-old woman who has been estranged from her family for some time, returns home when her mother dies under strange circumstances. There, she is reunited with her father, Martín, who since retiring seems to have become...

metas.name: Motor City
metas.description: In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl. In retaliation, the gangster enacts a frame job to send the innocent man to prison. Life ruined, Miller plots a revenge campaign against the man who took his girl away.

metas.name: Hadestown: The Musical
metas.description: A musical juxtaposition of the Orpheus/Eurydice and Hades/Persephone myths that examines the way real life can impact our quest for a perfect world.

metas.name: Pinocchio: Unstrung
metas.description: A dark coming-of-age reimagining of Pinocchio, this unsettling tale follows the iconic puppet's disturbing journey toward becoming real.

metas.name: 72 Hours
metas.description: A 40-year-old executive ends up at a three-day bachelor party with twenty-somethings after being mistakenly included in their chat group.

metas.name: Uma garota de classe
metas.description: A shocking murder rocks Brazil's elite when a wealthy food empire heir is killed by his wife. Based on true events that captivated the nation, this thriller delves into class divides, deadly ambition, and brutal consequences.

metas.name: A Toxic Love Story
metas.description: A string of threatening e-mails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly-married US Marshal and his ex-girlfriend.

metas.name: Evil Dead Burn
metas.description: After the loss of her husband, a woman seeks solace with her in-laws. As one by one they transform into deadites, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life - survive even in death.

metas.name: The Invite
metas.description: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places.

metas.name: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
metas.description: When her fiancé uses their "celebrity pass" agreement, Midwest bride Gail Daughtry travels to Hollywood seeking revenge by pursuing her own celebrity encounter.

metas.name: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
metas.description: Exclusive footage and survivor testimonies chronicle the 2012 sinking of a luxury cruise ship and its aftermath.

metas.name: Moana
metas.description: A brave teenager named Moana leaves her island for the first time and sails with a shape-shifting demigod named Maui to fix a dangerous curse.

metas.name: Young Washington
metas.description: A young George Washington faces war, betrayal and impossible choices that will forge a leader.

metas.name: Minions & Monsters
metas.description: Follows the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they search for frightening creatures for their monster movie, partner with a green creature, and must save the planet after unleashing monsters.

metas.name: Enola Holmes 3
metas.description: Detective Enola Holmes heads to Malta, where her aspirations merge in her most complex and dangerous case yet.

metas.name: Ridiculous
metas.description: Louis C.K. returns with a quintessential set that proves he's still a legend of the standup world.

metas.name: Jackass: Best and Last
metas.description: Follows the Jackass crew as they perform their final series of dangerous stunts and pranks, marking the end of the franchise.

metas.name: Supergirl
metas.description: Kara Zor-El, aka Supergirl, joins forces with an unlikely companion on an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice when an unexpected adversary strikes too close to home.

metas.name: The Get Out
metas.description: A nightclub owner is on the verge of leaving his dangerous past behind for retirement. After masked gunmen rob him and he finds himself squeezed by ruthless cartels, a mysterious newcomer arrives with an interest in buying the bus...

metas.name: Little Brother
metas.description: A famous real estate agent's life is disrupted when his eccentric little brother unexpectedly reappears.

metas.name: Two Prosecutors
metas.description: In the USSR in 1937, a newly appointed prosecutor discovers an undestroyed letter from a prisoner that reveals corruption in the secret police, the NKVD. His search for the truth becomes dangerous.

metas.name: Toy Story 5
metas.description: Woody, Buzz, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs are challenged when they're introduced to electronics, a new threat to playtime.

metas.name: The Death of Robin Hood
metas.description: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

metas.name: Voicemails for Isabelle
metas.description: Jill leaves voice messages to her deceased sister telling her about her chaotic life in San Francisco. Unwittingly, a mysterious Austin TX real estate agent begins to receive their confessions..

metas.name: Leviticus
metas.description: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most - each other.

metas.name: Citizen Vigilante
metas.description: A man takes justice into his own hands, hunting down criminals. His vigilante crusade makes him a social media star but puts him at odds with the local police chief.

metas.name: Husbands in Action
metas.description: An unpredictable operation by ex-husband Choong-sik and current husband Min-seok who unexpectedly join forces to rescue their wife who was kidnapped by a criminal organization.

metas.name: Your Fault: London
metas.description: A forbidden love story between 18-year-old Noah and stepbrother Nick faces challenges as they pursue different paths---him in business, her at Oxford---while dealing with new relationships and secrets.

metas.name: Disclosure Day
metas.description: If you found out we weren't alone, if someone showed you, proved it to you, would that frighten you?

metas.name: The Furious
metas.description: A father fights fiercely against ruthless kidnappers to save his abducted daughter.

metas.name: I Am Frankelda
metas.description: Frankelda, a determined 19th-century Mexican writer, journeys into her subconscious to face the monsters she's written about. Guided by a tormented prince, she must restore the balance between fiction and reality before it's too l...

metas.name: Affection
metas.description: Ellie confronts a disturbing condition resetting her memory, unable to recognize her husband and daughter. Each reset disorients her, leaving haunting recollections of an unfamiliar life.

metas.name: Masters of the Universe
metas.description: Prince Adam discovers that the strange memories shaping his life are real when the lost Sword of Power resurfaces, forcing him to return to Eternia and challenge the tyrant who shattered his family and kingdom.

metas.name: Signal One
metas.description: It tells the story of a computer scientist who is recruited by a tech billionaire to work on a project that could change humanity's place in the universe.

metas.name: The Marked Woman
metas.description: An unconscious woman is found in a Barcelona dock container. She awakens with no memory, and an attempt is made on her life in the hospital. Inspectors Ripoll and Zapori investigate the mysterious case.

metas.name: Office Romance
metas.description: Jackie, President and CEO of Air Cruz, runs a tight ship in her business, including a rigid anti-fraternization policy for all her employees. When a new sexy lawyer begins working for her, that policy becomes very tested.

metas.name: Scary Movie
metas.description: Two friends find themselves caught up in mayhem involving killers, monsters and supernatural creatures once again.

metas.name: Backrooms
metas.description: Clark, an angry architect, chases the source of impossible power failures when a glowing gap opens in his basement, but the yellow maze beyond it threatens his sanity, his friends, and Mary.
